scope: Available production stills and intentionally altered still fixtures only. Final encoded masters are not assessed by this calibration report.

negativeFixtures.scope: Temporary copies of production still with amber glyphs replaced by ivory, and a separate copy displaced horizontally by five pixels.

limits: Still calibration is not a full encoded-master check.
Both production and verification share the font rasterizer dependency; focus expectations and decoded-pixel checks are independent.
These fixtures demonstrate sensitivity to specific color and position faults, not every possible visual defect.
selectionImplementation: Balanced FFmpeg selection expression avoids parser-depth limits for hundreds of sparse frames.
